name: Availability-blind guardrail fade (ABGF)
signal: Between the 16:15 ET report the day before and the game-day 13:00 ET report, our line carries no availability signal; abstain or fade only our own conviction rather than trade a known blind spot.
universe: games in the T+0..T+3 window whose report window falls inside the blind window; a club that has not filed is excluded, never assumed healthy
settlement_rule: Official NBA final score against the originated line. A game with no official final is UNGRADED and never counted as a loss.
